question: Approve the launch-wrap-hook ideation design and answer its six questions?

artifacts.summary: Per-open wrap at agent.open.before with one-selection rule in validateBeforeResult; old hosts already reject unknown keys (strict schema); connect-first for plugin providers; wrap carried in ProviderSessionConfig for hook-less reopen; AgentClient opt-in (no protocol change); errors launch_wrap_unsupported / required_plugin_inactive. ~190 prod + 350 test lines, requiresPlugin commit ~95 + 150, ±30%. Six questions; largest: provider processes outside an open (probes, catalogs, draft command listing) stay unwrapped.
